plan: In a single-round sealed bid auction with rational opponents, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically near my private value. Since my value is $31, I want to win without overpaying. I'll bid slightly below my true value to maximize potential profit. Rational opponents will also bid strategically. I'll choose a bid that balances winning probability with profit margin - around $28-$30 seems optimal to create a buffer against overpaying while still having a strong chance of winning.

I'll bid $21.5 - a price just under my value that gives me a chance to win while protecting potential profit margin.
